_comment: NOAA-decoded METAR object -> the exact summary both implementations must render, compared as a whole string. Guards ceiling selection (first BKN/OVC, never FEW/SCT), the hPa->inHg conversion, wind wording, and rounding.

cases.label: Departure

metar.raw: METAR KJFK 201751Z 17008KT 10SM -RA FEW046 BKN100 OVC200 27/19 A2999

cases.expect:
Departure (KJFK): VFR · Wind 170° at 8kt · Vis 10+SM · Wx -RA · Ceiling BKN 10,000ft · 27°C/19°C · Altimeter 29.99inHg
  METAR KJFK 201751Z 17008KT 10SM -RA FEW046 BKN100 OVC200 27/19 A2999
cases.why: ceiling is the FIRST BKN/OVC layer - FEW046 is lower but is not a ceiling

cases.label: Departure
cases.expect:
Departure (KDFW): VFR · Wind 180° at 9kt gusting 15kt · Vis 10+SM · No ceiling reported · 38°C/19°C · Altimeter 29.98inHg
  METAR KDFW 201753Z 18009G15KT 10SM FEW250 38/19 A2998
cases.why: gusts render; FEW-only means no ceiling; absent wxString must omit the Wx segment entirely

cases.label: Arrival

metar.raw: METAR KMSP 201753Z 20011G18KT 9SM SCT120 BKN140 OVC250 24/15 A3002

cases.expect:
Arrival (KMSP): VFR · Wind 200° at 11kt gusting 18kt · Vis 9SM · Ceiling BKN 14,000ft · 24°C/15°C · Altimeter 30.01inHg
  METAR KMSP 201753Z 20011G18KT 9SM SCT120 BKN140 OVC250 24/15 A3002
cases.why: SCT120 is lower than BKN140 but is not a ceiling; numeric (non-string) visibility

cases.label: Departure
cases.expect:
Departure (KORD): LIFR · Wind calm · Vis 1/2SM · Wx FG · Ceiling OVC 200ft · 12°C/12°C · Altimeter 29.92inHg
  METAR KORD 201753Z 00000KT 1/2SM FG OVC002 12/12 A2992
cases.why: calm wording; LIFR; standard sea-level pressure 1013.25 hPa must convert to exactly 29.92 inHg

cases.label: Departure
cases.expect:
Departure (KDFW): VFR · Wind variable at 3kt · Vis 10+SM · No ceiling reported · 38°C/17°C · Altimeter 29.96inHg
  METAR KDFW 201853Z VRB03KT 10SM FEW250 38/17 A2996
cases.why: variable wind direction must not render as "VRB°"

cases.label: Arrival
cases.expect:
Arrival (PANC): VFR · Wind 90° at 4kt · Vis 10+SM · Ceiling BKN 3,500ft · -3°C/-5°C · Altimeter 29.81inHg
  METAR PANC 201753Z 09004KT 10SM BKN035 M02/M05 A2981
cases.why: NEGATIVE HALF-VALUE ROUNDING. JS Math.round(-2.5) is -2 but PHP round(-2.5) is -3. Both must round half away from zero.

cases.label: Departure
cases.expect:
Departure (KDEN): VFR · Wind 20° at 10kt · Vis 10+SM · No ceiling reported · 31°C/10°C · Altimeter 30.24inHg · Density alt 8,277ft
  METAR KDEN 201753Z 02010KT 10SM FEW100 31/10 A3024
  TAF KDEN 201720Z 2018/2124 04008KT P6SM SCT120
cases.why: density altitude and TAF both render; thousands separator on the DA figure

cases.label: Departure
cases.why: missing observation degrades to a plain statement, never a fabricated all-clear
